root.label: Federal judge dismisses Riley Gaines lawsuit against NCAA

events.label: Federal judge dismisses Riley Gaines lawsuit against NCAA

slots.name: lawsuit status
slots.sentence: A federal judge has dismissed a lawsuit against the National Collegiate Athletic Association concerning its former policy on transgender athletes’ eligibility in women’s college sports.

slots.name: compliance status
slots.sentence: In a statement to the outlet after the court’s ruling, NCAA spokesperson Meghan Wright said the organization “is proud to continually invest in and expand women’s sports and the NCAA is in full compliance with the Trump administration’s executive order on women’s sports.”

slots.name: ruling outcome
slots.sentence: In her ruling, Judge Tiffany R. Johnson held that the NCAA isn’t subject to Title IX protections because the organization doesn’t receive federal funding.

slots.name: filing date
slots.sentence: The plaintiffs filed the lawsuit in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Georgia, alleging the association’s policies violated their Title IX rights.
